topics.title_zh: 币安遭63亿美元洗劫创纪录，黑客利用AI大模型攻破安全网
topics.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3B Drain as Hackers Weaponize AI Models
topics.summary_zh: 黑客组织在20分钟内跨10条链卷走币安63.6亿美元，创加密史最大盗窃案。与此同时，CrowdStrike披露黑客利用集成DeepSeek等大模型的自动化工具11天连破9家机构，AI武器化已将攻防时差压缩至毫秒级。
topics.summary_en: TraderTraitor drained $6.36B from Binance across 10 blockchains in just 20 minutes, marking the largest crypto heist in history. Meanwhile, CrowdStrike exposed AI tools leveraging models like DeepSeek to automate enterprise breaches, proving cyberattacks have reached machine speed.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 币安与链上安全防守方
perspective_pro.point_zh: 全额赔付承诺与Tether、Circle紧急冻结23亿美元的协同行动，展现了中心化储备和跨链联防在应对极端黑客冲击时的兜底韧性。
perspective_pro.point_en: Binance's full compensation pledge and coordinated emergency freezes of $2.3B+ with Tether and Circle demonstrate that institutional reserves and rapid cross-chain intervention can still contain catastrophic fallout.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 网络安全专家与自动化审计派
perspective_con.point_zh: 大模型与自动化Agent正在大幅抹平攻防信息差，20分钟失守数十亿说明传统静态风控已死，AI赋能的恶意渗透正彻底摧毁金融基础设施脆弱的防线。
perspective_con.point_en: Automated LLM agents have completely skewed the asymmetric advantage toward attackers; losing billions in 20 minutes proves legacy perimeter defenses are obsolete against autonomous AI threats.

linked_news.title_zh: 币安遭遇63亿美元黑客洗劫
linked_news.title_en: TRM Labs attributes the Binance hack to North Korea-based TraderTraitor, which drained ~$6.36B from Binance wallets across 10 blockchains, mostly in ~20 minutes (Tom Westbrook/Reuters)

linked_news.title_zh: Binance 承诺承担约 6.3B 美元黑客攻击造成的所有损失，这可能是有史以来最大的加密货币盗窃案，超过 2025 年 2 月 Bybit 黑客攻击造成的 1.5B 美元（《南华早报》）
linked_news.title_en: Binance pledges to cover all losses from a ~$6.3B hack, potentially the largest crypto theft ever, surpassing the $1.5B Bybit hack in February 2025 (South China Morning Post)

linked_news.title_en: CrowdStrike: China-linked hackers used AI tool ARTEX with a DeepSeek LLM and another model to target 200+ organizations in 11 days, compromising at least nine (Kevin Collier/NBC News)

topics.title_zh: 亚马逊单季烧770亿基建现金流转负，大厂算力军备竞赛陷撕裂
topics.title_en: Amazon Burns $77B Capex Triggering $42B Cash Drain Amid AI War
topics.summary_zh: 亚马逊Q3云业务AWS营收大涨39%至近460亿美元，但单季资本支出狂烧超770亿美元导致自由现金流流出424亿美元。同时英伟达甚至开始为Anthropic算力中心初创厂商提供债务信贷担保，整个行业被卷入高杠杆算力赌局。
topics.summary_en: AWS delivered an impressive 39% revenue surge to $45.98B, yet Amazon spent a staggering $77B+ on capex in Q3, plunging free cash flow into a $42.4B deficit. Concurrently, Nvidia is underwriting debt guarantees for data centers, escalating the high-leverage infrastructure race.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 安迪·贾西及超大规模云厂商
perspective_pro.point_zh: 生成式AI正处于百年一遇的基础设施重塑期，AWS算力利用率极高且利润大增55%，必须用极致激进的前置资本支出锁定下一个十年的算力统治地位。
perspective_pro.point_en: Generative AI is a once-a-century platform shift; with AWS operating profit jumping 55%, aggressive upfront capital expenditure is non-negotiable to secure absolute infrastructure dominance.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 华尔街价值投资者与财务分析师
perspective_con.point_zh: 单季烧出400多亿美元现金缺口不可持续，供应商担保信贷的自融假象与终端ROI无法兑现的现实，正在重演电信泡沫时期的过度建设危机。
perspective_con.point_en: A $42.4B quarterly cash outflow is unsustainable. Vendor credit guarantees and circular compute financing resemble early telecom bubble dynamics where capital intensity vastly outpaces real-world monetized ROI.

linked_news.title_zh: 英伟达拟提供数十亿美元债务信贷担保，力挺初创云厂商建算力中心供大模型训练
linked_news.title_en: Sources: Nvidia is in talks to provide Nscale with billions of dollars in credit guarantees for debt to develop a 460MW data center that Anthropic plans to use (Phoebe Liu/The Information)
Amazon reports Q3 AWS revenue up 39% YoY to $45.98B, above $45.29B est., and AWS operating income up 55% to $17.77B, above $16.97B est. (Jordan Novet/CNBC)

linked_news.title_en: Amazon spent $77B+ on property and equipment in Q3, leading to a free cash outflow of $42.4B; Amazon said in July that it would likely spend $220B in 2026 capex (Matt Day/Bloomberg)

topics.title_zh: Claude Code扩展插件惊曝后门，AI代码助手成致命投毒跳板
topics.title_en: Anthropic Claude Code Extension Backdoored in Shocking Supply Attack
topics.summary_zh: 安全界突发披露官方Claude Code VS Code扩展插件遭恶意供应链篡改，安装可致远程SSH后门注入。加之此前埃森哲外包人员违规将Claude接入五角大楼核心系统，以Claude Code为代表的高权限自主编码Agent暴露出致命的供应链攻击面。
topics.summary_en: Security researchers revealed the official Claude Code VS Code extension was compromised with an SSH backdoor, while reports also surfaced of a contractor connecting Claude Code to sensitive Pentagon networks, sparking an industry-wide crisis over developer agent attack surfaces.

perspective_pro.speaker_zh: AI开发者工具与Agent架构团队
perspective_pro.point_zh: Claude Code代表了从对话助手迈向具备终端执行权的全自动软件工程范式，偶发的扩展分发漏洞属于传统供应链治理范畴，绝不能因噎废食扼杀开发效率革命。
perspective_pro.point_en: Claude Code pioneers true end-to-end autonomous engineering with terminal access. Toolchain packaging issues are standard supply-chain challenges that should be patched, not used to halt the AI workflow revolution.

perspective_con.speaker_zh: 企业首席信息安全官与渗透测试专家
perspective_con.point_zh: 将具备底层Shell执行权限的AI工具直接暴露于公网和开发者IDE是安全灾难，后门事件证明盲目赋予Agent系统级权限无异于主动向黑客敞开内网大门。
perspective_con.point_en: Granting autonomous execution and shell privileges inside developer IDEs without sandboxing is catastrophic. A backdoored agent extension turns every engineering laptop into an unmonitored lateral pivot for adversaries.
